ai_detail.single_biggest_weakness: A malformed events array (`}>` instead of `]}`) breaks the whole script per the separate automated check, and more importantly no code path anywhere ever sets colonist.assigned_building during real play (only the state-reverting runBenchmark() does), so the entire Greenhouse/Forge production chain and its adjacency/research bonuses never actually execute.
